name: GlzTabs
semanticRole: Switch among a small set of peer views while preserving one stable navigation context and an unambiguous selected tab.

material.rule: Underline or surface tabs are default in content. Glaze tabs are reserved for genuinely floating navigation surfaces; avoid oversized pill styling inside ordinary content.

input.keyboard: Arrow keys move among tabs according to orientation; Home and End reach bounds; activation follows the declared automatic or manual selection policy.
input.focus: Keyboard focus may move independently from selected state and both remain visually distinct.
input.hover: Hover adds restrained emphasis without moving the selected indicator.
input.press: Press feedback begins immediately; selected-indicator movement completes in approximately 180–220ms when motion is allowed.
input.selection: Exactly one tab is selected; selected state uses semibold label or accent plus underline/surface indicator.

accessibility.role: Use the tablist, tab, and tabpanel pattern with correct ownership and selected state.
accessibility.name: Each tab exposes its visible label as the programmatic name and each panel is associated with its tab.
accessibility.state: Selected, disabled, loading, and error state are exposed where applicable.
accessibility.value: The selected tab identity is exposed through selected-state semantics; no synthetic numeric value is required.
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow, Home, End, activation, and panel focus behavior follow established tabs conventions.
accessibility.focus: Focused and selected tabs remain separately identifiable.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Panel errors remain associated with the active panel and do not erase the tab relationship.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Indicator movement becomes direct or a short crossfade.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Glaze variant resolves to an opaque Raised or Surface treatment.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen selected indicator and focus ring.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system Highlight/Canvas/Text colors and preserve selected/focus structure.
accessibility.largeText: Tab labels wrap, scroll, or use an adaptive overflow pattern without clipping the active tab.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct indicator movement or short crossfade.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system selection/focus colors and explicit structure.
fallbacks.performance: Remove optional blur and decorative transition before changing selection semantics.

content.overflow: Tabs use controlled horizontal scrolling or semantic overflow when space is insufficient and never force page-level overflow.
content.localization: Labels and badges tolerate 30–50% expansion while preserving current-tab visibility.
content.rtl: Horizontal movement, order, indicators, and directional affordances mirror according to locale and platform conventions.

criteria: Selected tab is immediately clear without oversized content-area pills.
Focus and selected state are separately legible.
Indicator movement remains spatially continuous and restrained.
Long localized labels reflow or scroll without hiding the active tab.
